create_densepose_renderer: create a denseposeRenderer instance with custom width, height, and shader program files
load_densepose_info: load DensePose UV data from a .mat file to get face indices, U/V coordinates, and vertex IDs
set_densepose_mesh: set the mesh vertices and compute DensePose color data using U, V, and segmentation channels
add_densepose_mesh: concatenate a new mesh to existing vertex and color data as a single combined mesh
render_densepose_visualization: render a DensePose mesh with UV coordinates and part segmentation colors via OpenGL
